title: Sources: Jaxson Dart to have season-ending knee surgery - ESPN
description: Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart is expected to have season-ending knee surgery, sources told NFL Network.

title: Harvey Weinstein sentenced to 15 years on New York sex crime conviction - NBC News
description: Harvey Weinstein was sentenced to 15 years in prison Wednesday, more than a year after a jury found the former Hollywood mogul guilty of sexually assaulting former “Project Runway” production assistant Miriam Haley in a high-stakes retrial.

title: Super-sized El Niño could cause more than 450,000 heat deaths by February, study suggests - CNN
description: Nearly half a million people across the world could lose their lives by February due to El Niño-driven extreme heat, according to a sobering new report.

title: Fossil trove aims to unlock bats’ secrets to long life - Financial Times
description: Genomic and fossil records could offer clues to the mammal’s ability to kill damaged cells that might eventually improve human health

title: Ethiopia and Tigray accuse each of launching offensives, fuelling fears of new war - BBC
description: The local authorities reportedly seize Tigray's airports following reports of recent drone strikes.
